description.wurst.hack.airwalk: Lets you walk on a configurable Y level in mid-air.
description.wurst.hack.antivanish: Highlights and tracks entities that try to vanish from view.
description.wurst.hack.autocraft: Automatically crafts configured items while in a crafting screen.
description.wurst.hack.autotrader: Automates villager trading actions for selected trades.
description.wurst.hack.bedfinder: Searches loaded chunks for bed blocks and highlights nearby matches.
description.wurst.hack.blocklogger: Logs and highlights matching blocks, with save/load support.
description.wurst.hack.bookdupe: Attempts book-based duplication workflow used by some servers.
description.wurst.hack.bookkick: Sends oversized book payloads to kick vulnerable players/servers.
description.wurst.hack.dragonaimbot: Aims at Ender Dragons with optional prediction and smoothing.
description.wurst.hack.exploration: Automates movement and route progress for exploration tasks.
description.wurst.hack.filler: Places configured blocks to fill selected nearby spaces.
description.wurst.hack.gamemodenotifier: Notifies when your gamemode appears to change.
description.wurst.hack.gunaimbot: Aims ranged attacks at target entities with configurable behavior.
description.wurst.hack.infiniteexplorer: Continuously explores by extending exploration goals.
description.wurst.hack.invisreminder: Warns you when invisibility state needs attention.
description.wurst.hack.itemsearch: Searches for configured item targets in containers and results.
description.wurst.hack.itemtp: Teleports dropped items to your position on supported servers.
description.wurst.hack.nbtviewer: Displays NBT information for looked-at blocks and entities.
description.wurst.hack.opsign: Creates prefilled operator-style signs for quick placement.
description.wurst.hack.vehicleonehit: Destroys boats and minecarts by sending extra hit packets.
